intro.en: A mother and her son Sulayman are shocked by a high electricity bill. They talk about the many electric devices at home, and the mother suggests a clever idea to save electricity. Notice the word كَثيراً (kathīran) meaning 'a lot'.
intro.ur: Ek maa aur us ka beta Sulayman bijli ke zyada bill par hairan hain. Woh ghar ke bohat se bijli ke aalaat ka zikr karte hain, aur maa bijli bachane ka ek zaheen khayal pesh karti hai. Lafz كَثيراً (kathiran) yaani 'bohat' par ghaur karein.
intro.ar: تُفاجَأُ أُمٌّ وَابْنُها سُلَيْمانُ بِفاتورَةِ كَهْرَباءَ عالِيَةٍ. يَذْكُرانِ الأَجْهِزَةَ الكَهْرَبائِيَّةَ الكَثيرَةَ في البَيْتِ، وَتَقْتَرِحُ الأُمُّ فِكْرَةً ذَكِيَّةً لِتَوْفيرِ الكَهْرَباءِ. لاحِظْ كَلِمَةَ «كَثيراً».

dialogue.ar: يا سُلَيْمان، فاتورَةُ هذا الشَّهْرِ تَضاعَفَتْ؛ اُنْظُرْ إِلَيْها.
dialogue.tr: yā sulaymān, fātūratu hādhā sh-shahri taḍāʿafat; unẓur ilayhā.
dialogue.en: Sulayman, this month's bill has doubled; look at it.
dialogue.ur: Sulayman, is mahine ka bill dugna ho gaya hai; zara dekho.

dialogue.ar: لَسْتُ أَدْري يا أُمّي. لكِنَّنا نَسْتَعْمِلُ أَجْهِزَةً كَثيرَةً: الإِضاءَةَ وَالحاسوبَ وَالتِّلْفازَ وَالغَسّالَةَ وَالخَلّاطَ وَالفُرْنَ الكَهْرَبائِيَّ وَالمِكْنَسَةَ الكَهْرَبائِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: lastu adrī yā ummī. lkinnanā nastaʿmilu ajhizatan kathīrah: al-iḍāʾata wālḥāsūba wālttilfāza wālghassālata wālkhallāṭa wālfurna l-kahrabāʾiyya wālmiknasata l-kahrabāʾiyyah.
dialogue.en: I do not know, Mother. But we use many devices: lighting, the computer, the television, the washing machine, the blender, the electric oven and the vacuum cleaner.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe nahin maloom ammi. Lekin hum bohat se aalaat istemal karte hain: roshni, computer, TV, washing machine, blender, bijli ka tandoor aur vacuum cleaner.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أُلاحِظُ أَنَّ إِخْوَتَكَ يَنْسَوْنَ إِطْفاءَ المَصابيحِ وَالتِّلْفازِ، وَهذا تَبْذير.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā ulāḥiẓu anna ikhwataka yansawna iṭfāʾa l-maṣābīḥi wālttilfāz, wahdhā tabdhīr.
dialogue.en: And I notice that your brothers forget to turn off the lamps and the television, and this is waste.
dialogue.ur: Aur main dekhti hoon ke tumhare bhai bijliyan aur TV band karna bhool jate hain, aur yeh fuzool kharchi hai.

dialogue.ar: نَصَحْتُهُمْ كَثيراً، وَقُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ الفاتورَةَ تُؤَثِّرُ في مِيزانِيَّةِ البَيْتِ، وَلكِنَّهُمْ لا يَسْمَعون.
dialogue.tr: naṣaḥtuhum kathīran, waqultu lahum inna l-fātūrata tuʾaththiru fī mīzāniyyati l-bayt, walkinnahum lā yasmaʿūn.
dialogue.en: I advised them a lot and told them that the bill affects the household budget, but they do not listen.
dialogue.ur: Maine unhein bohat samjhaya aur kaha ke bill ghar ke budget par asar daalta hai, lekin woh sunte nahin.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدي فِكْرَةٌ: نَقولُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ مَنْ يُطْفِئُ الأَنْوارَ وَالأَجْهِزَةَ سَيَنالُ جائِزَةً في آخِرِ الشَّهْر.
dialogue.tr: ʿindī fikrah: naqūlu lahum inna man yuṭfiʾu l-anwāra wālʾajhizata sayanālu jāʾizatan fī ʾākhiri sh-shahr.
dialogue.en: I have an idea: we tell them that whoever switches off the lights and devices will get a prize at the end of the month.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas ek khayal hai: hum unhein kahein ke jo bijliyan aur aalaat band karega use mahine ke aakhir mein inaam milega.

dialogue.ar: هذا رَأْيٌ جَميلٌ يا أُمّي، فَلْنُجَرِّب.
dialogue.tr: hādhā raʾyun jamīlun yā ummī, falnujarrib.
dialogue.en: That is a lovely opinion, Mother; let us try.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bahut acha mashwara hai ammi; aaiye aazma kar dekhein.

dialogue.ar: جاءَتِ الفاتورَةُ الجَديدَةُ، وَقَدْ نَقَصَ المَبْلَغُ كَثيراً. نَجَحَتِ الفِكْرَة!
dialogue.tr: jāʾati l-fātūratu l-jadīdah, waqad naqaṣa l-mablaghu kathīran. najaḥati l-fikrah!
dialogue.en: The new bill has come, and the amount has dropped a lot. The idea worked!
dialogue.ur: Naya bill aa gaya hai, aur raqam bohat kam ho gayi hai. Khayal kamyab raha!

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلّهِ! وَالآنَ يَجِبُ أَنْ نُعْطِيَ كُلَّ واحِدٍ مُكافَأَة.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillh! wālʾāna yajibu an nuʿṭiya kulla wāḥidin mukāfaʾah.
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah! And now we must give each one a reward.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah! Aur ab hamein har ek ko inaam dena chahiye.

dialogue.ar: طَبْعاً، سَنَشْتَري لَهُمْ هَدايا جَميلَةً بِما وَفَّرْنا.
dialogue.tr: ṭabʿan, sanashtarī lahum hadāyā jamīlatan bimā waffarnā.
dialogue.en: Of course; we will buy them lovely gifts with what we saved.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor; jo hum ne bachaya us se un ke liye khoobsurat tohfe khareedenge.

q.en: What happened to the electricity bill at first?
q.ur: Shuru mein bill ke saath kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ لِفاتورَةِ الكَهْرَباءِ في البِدايَةِ؟

q.en: What does the mother propose to the children?
q.ur: Maa bachchon ko kya peshkash karti hai?

options: A prize for whoever switches off lights and devices

q.ur: 'Fuzool kharchi' ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الإِنْفاقَ الزّائِدَ بِلا فائِدَةٍ؟

title.en: Sounds review and signs of the genitive
title.ur: Aawaazein aur ism ke jarr ki nishaaniyan

intro.en: First we practise telling similar sounds apart (like ق/د, ن/ع). Then a grammar point: a noun after a preposition (like مِنْ, في, عِنْدَ) is 'majrūr'. Its ending changes: kasra for a singular noun (مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ), ya for dual and sound masculine plural (مِنَ الطّالِبَيْنِ), and fatha for diptotes (مِنْ أَحْمَدَ).
intro.ur: Pehle milti julti aawaazon mein farq karna mashq karte hain. Phir qaida: harf-e-jarr (مِنْ، في، عِنْدَ) ke baad ism 'majrūr' hota hai. Mufrad par kasra (مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ), muthanna aur jama muzakkar saalim par ya (مِنَ الطّالِبَيْنِ), aur mamnoo' minas-sarf par fatha (مِنْ أَحْمَدَ).
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ أَوَّلاً عَلى التَّفْريقِ بَيْنَ أَصْواتٍ مُتَشابِهَةٍ مِثْلَ ق/د وَن/ع. ثُمَّ قاعِدَةٌ: الاِسْمُ بَعْدَ حَرْفِ الجَرِّ (مِنْ، في، عِنْدَ) مَجْرورٌ، وَعَلامَتُهُ الكَسْرَةُ في المُفْرَدِ (مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ)، وَالياءُ في المُثَنّى وَجَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ (مِنَ الطّالِبَيْنِ)، وَالفَتْحَةُ في المَمْنوعِ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ (مِنْ أَحْمَدَ).

q.en: Which sign shows a singular noun is majrūr?
q.ur: Mufrad ism ke majrūr hone ki nishani kaun si hai?

q.en: Which is correct for the dual 'two students' after مِنَ?
q.ur: 'Do talib-ilm' ke liye مِنَ ke baad durust kaun sa hai?

q.en: «مِنْ أَحْمَدَ» ends with fatha because أَحْمَد is:
q.ur: «مِنْ أَحْمَدَ» mein fatha kyun hai? kyunke أَحْمَد:

q.en: A sound masculine plural is majrūr with:
q.ur: Jama muzakkar saalim ka jarr kis se hota hai?

q.en: Which phrase has a noun from the five nouns, majrūr?
q.ur: Asma-e-khamsa wala majrūr jumla kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ فيها اِسْمٌ مِنَ الأَسْماءِ الخَمْسَةِ مَجْرورٌ؟

title.en: Listening and speaking: water and electricity
title.ur: Sunna aur bolna: paani aur bijli

intro.en: Here you listen to a news report about Arab rivers, seas, water shortage and solar energy, then answer short questions. Then you discuss with classmates the uses of electricity and how to save water and power.
intro.ur: Yahan aap arab nadiyon, samundron, paani ki qillat aur sooraj ki tawanai ki khabar sun kar mukhtasar jawab dete hain. Phir sathiyon ke saath bijli ke faide aur paani/bijli bachane par baat karte hain.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى تَقْريرٍ عَنِ الأَنْهارِ وَالبِحارِ العَرَبِيَّةِ وَنَقْصِ المِياهِ وَالطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ تُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ قَصيرَةٍ. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ تُناقِشُ مَعَ زُمَلائِكَ فَوائِدَ الكَهْرَباءِ وَطُرُقَ تَوْفيرِ الماءِ وَالطّاقَةِ.

options_ar: مَجْرًى مائِيٌّ عَذْبٌ يَجْري في اليابِسَةِ

intro.en: This reading explains why oil is called 'black gold', how industries use it, where it is found, and why we must protect it because it is limited. Learn the key words in the vocabulary list.
intro.ur: Is parhne mein bataya gaya hai ke tel ko 'kaala sona' kyun kehte hain, sanatein isay kaise istemal karti hain, yeh kahan paya jata hai aur isay kyun bachana chahiye kyunke yeh mehdood hai. Aham alfaaz vocab mein dekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ يَشْرَحُ لِماذا يُسَمّى النَّفْطُ «الذَّهَبَ الأَسْوَدَ»، وَكَيْفَ تَسْتَعْمِلُهُ الصِّناعاتُ، وَأَيْنَ يوجَدُ، وَلِماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَحْمِيَهُ لِأَنَّهُ مَحْدودٌ. تَعَلَّمِ الكَلِماتِ المُهِمَّةَ في قائِمَةِ المُفْرَداتِ.

dialogue.ar: يُعَدُّ النِّفْطُ مِنَ الثَّرَواتِ الطَّبيعِيَّةِ الكُبْرى الَّتي تَمْلِكُها الأَرْض.
dialogue.tr: yuʿaddu n-nifṭu mina th-tharawāti ṭ-ṭabīʿiyyati l-kubrā illatī tamlikuhā l-arḍ.
dialogue.en: Oil is counted among the great natural resources that the earth holds.
dialogue.ur: Tel un bari qudrati daulaton mein shumar hota hai jo zameen ke paas hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُسَمّيهِ بَعْضُهُمُ الذَّهَبَ الأَسْوَدَ لِغَلاءِ ثَمَنِهِ وَقيمَتِهِ، وَيُسَمّيهِ آخَرونَ شِرْيانَ الحَياة.
dialogue.tr: wayusammīhi baʿḍuhumu dh-dhahaba l-aswada lighalāʾi thamanihi waqīmatih, wayusammīhi ʾākharūna shiryāna l-ḥayāh.
dialogue.en: Some call it black gold because of its high price and value, and others call it the artery of life.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log ise us ki bari qeemat ki wajah se kaala sona kehte hain, aur doosre ise shah-rag-e-hayat kehte hain.

dialogue.ar: لا تَسيرُ الطّائِراتُ وَالسُّفُنُ وَالقِطاراتُ وَالشّاحِناتُ وَالسَّيّاراتُ إِلّا بِالنِّفْط.
dialogue.tr: lā tasīru ṭ-ṭāʾirātu wālssufunu wālqiṭārātu wālshshāḥinātu wālssayyārātu illā bilnnifṭ.
dialogue.en: Planes, ships, trains, trucks and cars run only on oil.
dialogue.ur: Jahaz, kashtiyan, trainein, truck aur gaariyan sirf tel se chalti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَنِصْفُ الطّاقَةِ الَّتي يَحْتاجُها العالَمُ يَأْتي مِنَ النِّفْط.
dialogue.tr: waniṣfu ṭ-ṭāqati illatī yaḥtājuhā l-ʿālamu yaʾtī mina n-nifṭ.
dialogue.en: Half of the energy the world needs comes from oil.
dialogue.ur: Duniya ko jis tawanai ki zaroorat hai us ka aadha hissa tel se aata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَسْتَعْمِلُهُ المَصانِعُ في صُنْعِ الوَقودِ وَالمَنْسوجاتِ وَالسَّجّادِ وَالبَلاسْتيكِ وَالأَسْمِدَةِ وَمُسْتَحْضَراتِ التَّجْميل.
dialogue.tr: watastaʿmiluhu l-maṣāniʿu fī ṣunʿi l-waqūdi wālmansūjāti wālssajjādi wālbalāstīki wālʾasmidati wamustaḥḍarāti t-tajmīl.
dialogue.en: Factories use it to make fuel, textiles, carpets, plastic, fertilizers and cosmetics.
dialogue.ur: Karkhane ise eendhan, kapde, qaleen, plastic, khaad aur sajawati samaan banane mein istemal karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَبْحَثُ العُلَماءُ عَنْ بَديلٍ لَهُ، لكِنَّ هذا البَحْثَ طَويلٌ وَصَعْب.
dialogue.tr: wayabḥathu l-ʿulamāʾu ʿan badīlin lah, lākin hādhā l-baḥtha ṭawīlun waṣaʿb.
dialogue.en: Scientists are searching for an alternative to it, but this search is long and difficult.
dialogue.ur: Ulama is ka koi badal talash kar rahe hain, lekin yeh talash lambi aur mushkil hai.

dialogue.ar: وَاحْتِياطُ العالَمِ مِنَ النِّفْطِ يُقاسُ بِمِئاتِ المِلْياراتِ مِنَ البَراميلِ، وَأَكْثَرُهُ في دُوَلِ الخَليجِ العَرَبِيِّ وَغَيْرِها.
dialogue.tr: wāḥtīṭu l-ʿālami mina n-nifṭi yuqāsu bimiʾāti l-milyārāti mina l-barāmīl, waʾaktharuhu fī duwali l-khalīji l-ʿarabiyyi waghayrihā.
dialogue.en: The world's reserve of oil is measured in hundreds of billions of barrels, most of it in the Arab Gulf states and elsewhere.
dialogue.ur: Duniya ka tel ka zakheera sau arab barrel ke hisab se napa jata hai, jis ka zyadatar hissa Khaleeji Arab mulkon aur doosri jagahon mein hai.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّ النِّفْطَ مَحْدودٌ وَسَيَنْفَدُ يَوْماً ما، فَعَلى كُلِّ فَرْدٍ وَدَوْلَةٍ أَنْ يَحْفَظوهُ وَلا يُسْرِفوا فيه.
dialogue.tr: lākin n-nifṭa maḥdūdun wasayanfadu yawman mā, faʿalā kulli fardin wadawlatin an yaḥfaẓūhu walā yusrifū fīh.
dialogue.en: But oil is limited and will run out one day, so every individual and state must preserve it and not be wasteful with it.
dialogue.ur: Lekin tel mehdood hai aur ek din khatam ho jayega, is liye har fard aur mulk ko chahiye ke use bachaye aur us mein israaf na kare.

q.en: Why do some people call oil 'black gold'?
q.ur: Kuch log tel ko 'kaala sona' kyun kehte hain?

options: Because it is very valuable / Bahut qeemti hai
Because it is found in gold mines
Because it is dark at night

q.en: What does the text say about oil?
q.ur: Matn tel ke baare mein kya kehta hai?

options: It is limited and will end one day / Mehdood hai
It is found only in one country
options_ar: أَنَّهُ يوجَدُ في بَلَدٍ واحِدٍ فَقَطْ

options: Half of the energy / Aadhi tawanai
options_ar: واحِدٌ مِنِ اثْنَيْنِ مُتَساوِيَيْنِ مِنَ الطّاقَةِ

q.en: What should individuals and states do about oil?
q.ur: Afraad aur mumalik ko tel ke baare mein kya karna chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَجِبُ عَلى الأَفْرادِ وَالدُّوَلِ فِعْلُهُ تُجاهَ النَّفْطِ؟

intro.en: A review of five grammar topics: the adverb (ظَرْف) of time or place, the five nouns, the number's tamyiz (noun after a number), the five verbs, and the vocative (المُنادى).
intro.ur: Paanch nahwi mauzoo'at ka muraja'a: zarf (waqt ya jagah), asma-e-khamsa, adad ka tamyeez, af'al-e-khamsa aur munada.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِخَمْسَةِ مَوْضوعاتٍ نَحْوِيَّةٍ: ظَرْفُ الزَّمانِ أَوِ المَكانِ، وَالأَسْماءُ الخَمْسَةُ، وَتَمْييزُ العَدَدِ، وَالأَفْعالُ الخَمْسَةُ، وَالمُنادى.

q.en: Which is an adverb of time?
The five verbs are present tense verbs joined to:
q.ur: Af'al-e-khamsa mudari' hain jin ke saath juRe hon:
q.ar: الأَفْعالُ الخَمْسَةُ أَفْعالٌ مُضارِعَةٌ يَتَّصِلُ بِها...

options: Alif of dual, waw of group, ya of the addressed woman
options_ar: أَلِفُ الاِثْنَيْنِ أَوْ واوُ الجَماعَةِ أَوْ ياءُ المُخاطَبَةِ

q.en: After a number 11 to 99 the tamyiz noun is:
q.ur: 11 se 99 ke adad ke baad tamyeez hota hai:
q.ar: بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ١١ إِلى ٩٩ يَكونُ المَعْدودُ...

q.en: In «يا مُحَمَّدُ» the vocative is built on:
Which is one of the five nouns?

intro.en: Fadi and Karim talk about the oil crisis: why fuel prices rise, and the dispute between industrial countries and oil-producing countries. Then a quick drill on words from the same root.
intro.ur: Fadi aur Karim tel ke bohran par baat karte hain: eendhan ki qeematein kyun barhti hain, aur sanati mulkon aur tel paida karne wale mulkon ke darmiyan kya jhagra hai. Phir ek hi maadday ke alfaaz par ek tez mashq.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ فادي وَكَريمٌ عَنْ أَزْمَةِ النِّفْطِ: لِماذا تَرْتَفِعُ أَسْعارُ الوَقودِ، وَما الخِلافُ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ وَالدُّوَلِ المُنْتِجَةِ لِلنِّفْطِ. ثُمَّ تَدْريبٌ سَريعٌ عَلى كَلِماتٍ مِنْ جَذْرٍ واحِدٍ.

dialogue.ar: تَجَدَّدَتْ أَزْمَةُ الوَقودِ هذا الأُسْبوع.
dialogue.tr: tajaddadat azmatu l-waqūdi hādhā l-usbūʿ.
dialogue.en: The fuel crisis has returned this week.
dialogue.ur: Is hafte eendhan ka bohran phir laut aaya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ قَفَزَتْ أَسْعارُ البِنْزينِ، وَلا يَجِدُ النّاسُ ما يَكْفيهِمْ مِنْهُ، فَالمَعْروضُ قَليل.
dialogue.tr: waqad qafazat asʿāru l-binzīn, walā yajidu n-nāsu mā yakfīhim minh, fālmaʿrūḍu qalīl.
dialogue.en: And petrol prices have jumped, and people cannot find enough of it, for the supply is small.
dialogue.ur: Aur petrol ki qeematein uchhal gayi hain, aur logon ko kaafi nahin milta, kyunke supply kam hai.

dialogue.ar: لِهذا تَرَكْتُ سَيّارَتي في البَيْتِ، وَأَرْكَبُ الحافِلَةَ إِلى الشَّرِكَةِ كُلَّ صَباح.
dialogue.tr: lihdhā taraktu sayyāratī fī l-bayt, waʾarkabu l-ḥāfilata ilā sh-sharikati kulla ṣabāḥ.
dialogue.en: That is why I left my car at home, and I ride the bus to the company every morning.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye maine apni gaari ghar chhor di hai, aur har subah bus mein company jata hoon.

dialogue.ar: ما أَسْبابُ هذِهِ الأَزْمَةِ في رَأْيِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: mā asbābu hādhihi l-azmati fī raʾyik?
dialogue.en: What are the causes of this crisis in your opinion?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki raaye mein is bohran ke asbaab kya hain?

dialogue.ar: يَرْجِعُ الأَمْرُ إِلى خِلافٍ بَيْنَ دُوَلٍ تُصَنِّعُ كَثيراً وَدُوَلٍ تَبيعُ النِّفْط.
dialogue.tr: yarjiʿu l-amru ilā khilāfin bayna duwalin tuṣanniʿu kathīran waduwalin tabīʿu n-nifṭ.
dialogue.en: It goes back to a dispute between countries that manufacture a lot and countries that sell oil.
dialogue.ur: Baat un mulkon ke jhagre par jati hai jo bohat sanat banate hain aur un mulkon par jo tel bechte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَما سَبَبُ اخْتِلافِ هذِهِ الدُّوَلِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamā sababu ikhtilāfi hādhihi d-duwal?
dialogue.en: And what is the reason these countries differ?
dialogue.ur: Aur in mulkon ke ikhtilaf ki wajah kya hai?

dialogue.ar: تَدَّعي الدُّوَلُ الصِّناعِيَّةُ أَنَّ ارْتِفاعَ الأَسْعارِ سَبَبُهُ المُنْتِجونَ، وَيَرُدُّ هؤُلاءِ بِأَنَّ الضَّرائِبَ الَّتي تَفْرِضُها تِلْكَ الدُّوَلُ عَلى الوَقودِ باهِظَة.
dialogue.tr: taddaʿī d-duwalu ṣ-ṣināʿiyyatu anna irtifāʿa l-asʿāri sababuhu l-muntijūn, wayaruddu hāʾulāʾi biʾanna ḍ-ḍarāʾiba illatī tafriḍuhā tilka d-duwalu ʿalā l-waqūdi bāhiẓah.
dialogue.en: The industrial countries claim that the rise in prices is caused by the producers, and these reply that the taxes those countries impose on fuel are exorbitant.
dialogue.ur: Sanati mulk dawa karte hain ke qeematon ke izafe ki wajah paida karne wale hain, aur woh jawab dete hain ke un mulkon ke eendhan par lagaye hue tax bohat bhari hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالفُقَراءُ في العالَمِ، ماذا عَنْهُمْ؟ لا ذَنْبَ لَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wālfuqarāʾu fī l-ʿālam, mādhā ʿanhum? lā dhanba lahum.
dialogue.en: And the poor of the world, what about them? They are not at fault.
dialogue.ur: Aur duniya ke ghareeb, un ka kya? Un ka koi qusoor nahin.

dialogue.ar: صَدَقْتَ، فَالدُّوَلُ الفَقيرَةُ لا تَمْلِكُ مَصانِعَ كَبيرَةً وَلا تُصَدِّرُ نِفْطاً.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqt, fāldduwalu l-faqīratu lā tamliku maṣāniʿa kabīratan walā tuṣaddiru nifṭan.
dialogue.en: You are right; poor countries do not own big factories and do not export oil.
dialogue.ur: Aap sach kehte hain; ghareeb mulkon ke paas bare karkhane nahin hote aur woh tel bhi bar-aamad nahin karte.

dialogue.ar: وَهكَذا يَدْفَعونَ ثَمَنَ خِلافِ الآخَرين.
dialogue.tr: wahkadhā yadfaʿūna thamana khilāfi l-ʾākharīn.
dialogue.en: And so they pay the price of the others' dispute.
dialogue.ur: Yoon woh doosron ke jhagre ki qeemat chukate hain.

dialogue.ar: يُفَكِّرُ كُلُّ طَرَفٍ في مَصْلَحَةِ شَعْبِهِ وَيَنْسى بَقِيَّةَ العالَم.
dialogue.tr: yufakkiru kullu ṭarafin fī maṣlaḥati shaʿbihi wayansā baqiyyata l-ʿālam.
dialogue.en: Each side thinks of the interest of its own people and forgets the rest of the world.
dialogue.ur: Har fareeq apne logon ki bhalai sochta hai aur baqi duniya ko bhool jata hai.

dialogue.ar: اللّهُمَّ كُنْ في عَوْنِ الفُقَراءِ وَالمَحْرومين.
dialogue.tr: al-lhumma kun fī ʿawni l-fuqarāʾi wālmaḥrūmīn.
dialogue.en: O Allah, be a help to the poor and the deprived.
dialogue.ur: Ae Allah, ghareebon aur mehroomon ka madadgar ban jaa.

q.en: Why does Fadi go by bus now?
q.ur: Fadi ab bus mein kyun jata hai?

options: He does not use his car because of the fuel crisis / Eendhan ka bohran hai
options_ar: لا يَسْتَعْمِلُ سَيّارَتَهُ بِسَبَبِ أَزْمَةِ الوَقودِ

q.en: What do industrial countries claim about the producers?
q.ur: Sanati mumalik paida karne walon ke baare mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَدَّعي الدُّوَلُ الصِّناعِيَّةُ عَنِ الدُّوَلِ المُنْتِجَةِ؟

options: They raise prices / Qeematein barhate hain

q.ur: Paida karne wale mumalik kya kehte hain?

options: Industrial countries impose high taxes on fuel / Sanati mumalik bhari tax lagate hain
options_ar: إِنَّ الدُّوَلَ الصِّناعِيَّةَ تَفْرِضُ ضَرائِبَ عالِيَةً عَلى الوَقودِ

intro.en: More review: the circumstantial state (الحال) describes the state of the doer or of the object; nouns are indefinite or definite (a name, or with ال). Then you practise asking and answering about oil in your own country.
intro.ur: Mazeed muraja'a: haal fa'il ya maf'ool ki haalat bayan karta hai; ism nakira ya ma'rifa hota hai (alam ya ال wala). Phir apne mulk mein tel ke baare mein sawal-jawab mashq karte hain.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ أُخْرى: الحالُ يَصِفُ هَيْئَةَ الفاعِلِ أَوِ المَفْعولِ بِهِ، وَالاِسْمُ نَكِرَةٌ أَوْ مَعْرِفَةٌ (عَلَمٌ أَوْ مُعَرَّفٌ بِـ «ال»). ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ عَنِ النَّفْطِ في بَلَدِكَ.

options: The state of the doer or the object / Fa'il ya maf'ool ki haalat
options_ar: هَيْئَةَ الفاعِلِ أَوِ المَفْعولِ بِهِ وَقْتَ الفِعْلِ

q.en: Which is a definite noun with ال?
q.ur: ال wala ma'rifa ism kaun sa?

q.ar: عَمّا يَسْأَلُ السُّؤالُ «هَلْ يُصَدِّرُ بَلَدُكَ النِّفْطَ؟»

intro.en: The sun is the basic source of energy on Earth. This reading explains how people use solar energy for cooking, heating water and making electricity, and why attempts to use it will continue.
intro.ur: Sooraj zameen par tawanai ka asal zariya hai. Is parhne mein hai ke insaan sooraj ki tawanai khana pakane, paani garam karne aur bijli banane mein kaise istemal karta hai, aur ismein koshishein kyun jaari rahengi.
intro.ar: الشَّمْسُ هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الأَساسِيُّ لِلطّاقَةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ. يَشْرَحُ النَّصُّ كَيْفَ يَسْتَعْمِلُ النّاسُ الطّاقَةَ الشَّمْسِيَّةَ في الطَّبْخِ وَتَسْخينِ الماءِ وَتَوْليدِ الكَهْرَباءِ، وَلِماذا سَتَسْتَمِرُّ مُحاوَلاتُ الاِسْتِفادَةِ مِنْها.

dialogue.ar: تُرْسِلُ الشَّمْسُ، وَهِيَ نَجْمٌ كَبيرٌ في السَّماءِ، أَكْثَرَ الطّاقَةِ الَّتي تَصِلُ إِلى الأَرْضِ، فَهِيَ مَصْدَرُها الأَساسِيّ.
dialogue.tr: tursilu sh-shams, wahiya najmun kabīrun fī s-samāʾ, akthara ṭ-ṭāqati illatī taṣilu ilā l-arḍ, fahiya maṣdaruhā l-asāsiyy.
dialogue.en: The sun, a great star in the sky, sends most of the energy that reaches the earth, so it is its basic source.
dialogue.ur: Sooraj, jo aasman ka ek bara sitara hai, zameen tak pahunchne wali zyadatar tawanai bhejta hai, is liye yeh us ka bunyadi zariya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِنْسانُ وَالحَيَوانُ وَالنَّباتُ يَعيشونَ بِفَضْلِ اللهِ ثُمَّ بِفَضْلِ حَرارَةِ أَشِعَّتِها.
dialogue.tr: wālʾinsānu wālḥayawānu wālnnabātu yaʿīshūna bifaḍli llāh thumma bifaḍli ḥarārati ashiʿʿatihā.
dialogue.en: Humans, animals and plants live by Allah's grace and then by the heat of its rays.
dialogue.ur: Insan, janwar aur paudhe Allah ke fazal se aur phir us ki shuaaon ki garmi se jeete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ دونِ هذِهِ الحَرارَةِ لا تَبْقى حَياةٌ في الأَرْض.
dialogue.tr: wamin dūni hādhihi l-ḥarārati lā tabqā ḥayātun fī l-arḍ.
dialogue.en: Without this heat no life would remain on earth.
dialogue.ur: Is garmi ke baghair zameen mein zindagi baqi nahin rehti.

dialogue.ar: وَمُنْذُ زَمَنٍ بَعيدٍ يَسْتَفيدُ النّاسُ مِنْها في تَسْخينِ الماءِ وَتَدْفِئَةِ المَنازِلِ وَطَبْخِ الطَّعام.
dialogue.tr: wamundhu zamanin baʿīdin yastafīdu n-nāsu minhā fī taskhīni l-māʾi watadfiʾati l-manāzili waṭabkhi ṭ-ṭaʿām.
dialogue.en: Since long ago people have benefited from it in heating water, warming homes and cooking food.
dialogue.ur: Bohat purane zamane se log us se paani garam karne, gharon ko garm rakhne aur khana pakane mein faida uthate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَاليَوْمَ نَجَحَ العُلَماءُ في تَوْليدِ الكَهْرَباءِ مِنْ ضَوْءِ الشَّمْسِ بِاسْتِعْمالِ خَلايا خاصَّةٍ، وَذلِكَ في بِلادٍ حارَّةٍ مُشْمِسَة.
dialogue.tr: wālyawma najaḥa l-ʿulamāʾu fī tawlīdi l-kahrabāʾi min ḍawʾi sh-shamsi bistiʿmāli khalāyā khāṣṣah, wadhlika fī bilādin ḥārratin mushmisah.
dialogue.en: Today scientists have succeeded in generating electricity from sunlight using special cells, in hot, sunny countries.
dialogue.ur: Aaj ulama khaas khaliyon ke zariye sooraj ki roshni se bijli paida karne mein kamyab hue hain, garm aur dhoop wale mulkon mein.

dialogue.ar: وَتُثَبَّتُ الأَلْواحُ الشَّمْسِيَّةُ عَلى أَسْطُحِ المَنازِلِ لِتَلْتَقِطَ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ وَتُحَوِّلَهُ إِلى كَهْرَباء.
dialogue.tr: watuthabbatu l-alwāḥu sh-shamsiyyatu ʿalā asṭuḥi l-manāzili litaltaqiṭa ḍawʾa sh-shamsi watuḥawwilahu ilā kahrabāʾ.
dialogue.en: Solar panels are fixed on the roofs of houses to catch the sunlight and turn it into electricity.
dialogue.ur: Solar panel gharon ki chhaton par lagaye jate hain taake dhoop ki roshni ko pakar kar bijli mein badal dein.

dialogue.ar: وَهذِهِ الطّاقَةُ نَظيفَةٌ لا تُلَوِّثُ الجَوَّ، وَهِيَ وَفيرَةٌ في المَناطِقِ المُشْمِسَة.
dialogue.tr: wahdhihi ṭ-ṭāqatu naẓīfatun lā tulawwithu l-jaww, wahiya wafīratun fī l-manāṭiqi l-mushmisah.
dialogue.en: This energy is clean and does not pollute the air, and it is plentiful in sunny regions.
dialogue.ur: Yeh tawanai saaf hai aur hawa ko aloodah nahin karti, aur dhoop wale ilaqon mein bohat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَسَتَسْتَمِرُّ مُحاوَلاتُ الاسْتِفادَةِ مِنْها، فَمَصادِرُ الطّاقَةِ الأُخْرى سَتَنْتَهي يَوْماً ما، وَالشَّمْسُ باقِيَةٌ ما شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: wasatastamirru muḥāwalātu l-istifādati minhā, famaṣādiru ṭ-ṭāqati l-ukhrā satantahī yawman mā, wālshshamsu bāqiyatun mā shāʾa llāh.
dialogue.en: Attempts to benefit from it will continue, for the other sources of energy will end one day, while the sun remains as Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Is se faida uthane ki koshishein jari rahengi, kyunke tawanai ke doosre zaraye ek din khatam ho jayenge, aur sooraj Allah ki marzi tak baqi hai.

q.en: What is the basic source of energy on Earth?
q.ur: Zameen par tawanai ka bunyadi zariya kya hai?
q.ar: ما المَصْدَرُ الأَساسِيُّ لِلطّاقَةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ؟

options_ar: أَجْهِزَةٌ تَلْتَقِطُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ وَتُحَوِّلُهُ إِلى كَهْرَباءَ

q.ur: Sooraj ki tawanai kahan bohat hai?

options: In sunny regions / Dhoop wale ilaqon mein

q.en: Why will attempts to use solar energy not stop?
q.ur: Sooraj ki tawanai ki koshishein kyun nahi rukengi?
q.ar: لِماذا لَنْ تَتَوَقَّفَ مُحاوَلاتُ اِسْتِعْمالِ الطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ؟

options: Other sources will run out, the sun remains / Doosre zaraye khatam honge
options_ar: لِأَنَّ المَصادِرَ الأُخْرى سَتَنْفَدُ وَالشَّمْسُ باقِيَةٌ

intro.en: A big review: separate and attached pronouns, 'kāna' and 'inna' (the نَواسِخ), the dual and sound masculine plural endings, and the five nouns (أَبو/أَبا/أَبي). Example: المُسْلِمونَ (nominative) but المُؤْمِنينَ (accusative or genitive).
intro.ur: Bara muraja'a: zamair, kana aur inna, muthanna aur jama muzakkar saalim ke aakhir, aur asma-e-khamsa (أَبو/أَبا/أَبي). Misal: المُسْلِمونَ (marfoo') lekin المُؤْمِنينَ (mansoob ya majroor).
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ: الضَّمائِرُ المُنْفَصِلَةُ وَالمُتَّصِلَةُ، وَ«كانَ» وَ«إِنَّ» (النَّواسِخُ)، وَنِهاياتُ المُثَنّى وَجَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ، وَالأَسْماءُ الخَمْسَةُ (أَبو/أَبا/أَبي). مِثالٌ: المُسْلِمونَ (مَرْفوعٌ) وَالمُؤْمِنينَ (مَنْصوبٌ أَوْ مَجْرورٌ).

q.en: المُسْلِمونَ ends with waw because it is:
q.ur: المُسْلِمونَ mein waw kyun hai? kyunke yeh:

q.en: المُؤْمِنينَ is used in the case of:
q.ur: المُؤْمِنينَ kis halat mein aata hai?

options: Accusative or genitive / Nasb ya jarr

q.en: «أَبا هُرَيْرَةَ» has alif because it is a five-noun in:
q.ar: في أَيِّ حالَةٍ إِعْرابِيَّةٍ جاءَتْ «أَبا» في «أَبا هُرَيْرَةَ»؟

intro.en: Writing practice. You write short topics: 'The problem of electricity use at home', 'Oil is the most important source of energy', and 'The oil crisis'. Then you copy a line of poetry in Ruq'a script, and learn a spelling rule: drop the final ya of a 'manqūṣ' noun when it has no ال and is not mudaf (e.g. مُحامٍ).
intro.ur: Likhne ki mashq. Aap in mauzoo'at par likhte hain: 'Ghar mein bijli ke istemal ka masla', 'Tel tawanai ka sab se aham zariya', aur 'Tel ka bohran'. Phir ruq'a khat mein ek sher likhte hain, aur imla ka qaida: ism-e-manqoos ki aakhri ya hazf hoti hai jab ال na ho aur mudaf na ho (jaise مُحامٍ).
intro.ar: تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: مَوْضوعاتٌ قَصيرَةٌ عَنْ «مُشْكِلَةِ اِسْتِهْلاكِ الكَهْرَباءِ في البَيْتِ» وَ«النِّفْطُ أَهَمُّ مَصْدَرٍ لِلطّاقَةِ» وَ«أَزْمَةِ النَّفْطِ». ثُمَّ تَنْسَخُ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، وَتَتَعَلَّمُ قاعِدَةً إِمْلائِيَّةً: تُحْذَفُ ياءُ الاِسْمِ المَنْقوصِ إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ مُعَرَّفاً بِـ «ال» وَلا مُضافاً، مِثْلَ «مُحامٍ».

vocab.en: noun ending in a long i (ya)

q.en: Which is a topic to write about in this lesson?
q.ur: Is sabaq mein kis mauzoo par likhna hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عُنْوانٍ مَوْضوعٌ لِلكِتابَةِ في هذا الدَّرْسِ؟
ما المَقْصودُ بِعِبارَةِ «النِّفْطُ أَهَمُّ مَصْدَرٍ لِلطّاقَةِ»؟

options: Oil is the most important source of energy
options_ar: أَنَّ النَّفْطَ أَكْبَرُ مَصادِرِ الطّاقَةِ قيمَةً

q.en: When is the final ya of a manqūṣ noun dropped?
q.ur: Manqoos ism ki aakhri ya kab girti hai?

options: When it has no ال and is not mudaf / Jab ال na ho aur mudaf na ho
options_ar: إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ مُعَرَّفاً بِـ «ال» وَلا مُضافاً

q.ur: Durust imla kaun sa hai (nakira, marfoo')?
q.ar: أَيُّ كِتابَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلاِسْمِ النَّكِرَةِ المَرْفوعِ؟

q.en: The poem line says great souls get tired in:
q.ur: Sher ke mutabiq bari rooheen thakti hain:
q.ar: يَقولُ بَيْتُ الشِّعْرِ إِنَّ النُّفوسَ الكَبيرَةَ تَتْعَبُ في...

options: What their bodies pursue / Apne maqasid mein (jism thakte hain)
options_ar: طَلَبِ ما تَسْعى إِلَيْهِ مِنْ مَقاصِدَ

intro.en: A review test with word lists: electricity and energy words, oil and sun words, pollution and energy words, and common phrases like دُوَل مُنْتِجَة (producing countries) and ذَهَب أَسْوَد (black gold). Also spelling pairs such as مَسْؤولِيَّة and أَداء.
intro.ur: Muraja'a ka imtihan: bijli aur tawanai ke alfaaz, tel aur sooraj ke alfaaz, aur aam jumle jaise دُوَل مُنْتِجَة (paida karne wale mumalik) aur ذَهَب أَسْوَد (kaala sona). Imla ke joray jaise مَسْؤولِيَّة aur أَداء bhi.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ فيهِ قَوائِمُ كَلِماتٍ: الكَهْرَباءِ وَالطّاقَةِ، وَالنَّفْطِ وَالشَّمْسِ، وَالتَّلَوُّثِ وَالطّاقَةِ، وَعِباراتٍ شائِعَةٍ مِثْلَ «دُوَل مُنْتِجَة» وَ«ذَهَب أَسْوَد». وَفيهِ أَيْضاً أَزْواجٌ إِمْلائِيَّةٌ مِثْلَ «مَسْؤولِيَّة» وَ«أَداء».

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني القُوَّةَ الَّتي تُضيءُ المَصابيحَ وَتُشَغِّلُ الأَجْهِزَةَ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما نَحْرِقُهُ لِتَشْغيلِ السَّيّاراتِ؟

q.ur: Tawanai ke tehat kaun sa lafz?

intro.en: The final test covers listening, reading, grammar and vocabulary. There are true/false statements, singular-plural pairs (شَخْص – أَشْخاص), and words with similar meanings (غَرَسَ – زَرَعَ).
intro.ur: Aakhri imtihan mein sunna, parhna, nahw aur alfaaz shamil hain. Sahi/ghalat jumle hain, wahid-jama ke joray (شَخْص – أَشْخاص), aur milte julte maani wale alfaaz (غَرَسَ – زَرَعَ).
intro.ar: يَشْمَلُ الاِخْتِبارُ النِّهائِيُّ الاِسْتِماعَ وَالقِراءَةَ وَالقَواعِدَ وَالمُفْرَداتِ. فيهِ عِباراتٌ صَحيحَةٌ أَوْ خاطِئَةٌ، وَأَزْواجٌ مِنَ المُفْرَدِ وَالجَمْعِ (شَخْص – أَشْخاص)، وَكَلِماتٌ مُتَقارِبَةُ المَعْنى (غَرَسَ – زَرَعَ).

q.en: Which word is close in meaning to «عادَ»?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ قَريبَةٌ في المَعْنى مِنْ «عادَ»؟
